blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in The Crest. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

The Crest, Burnaby: 14 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 13 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in The Crest fell from 16 in June to 14 in September (−12.5%), and 7 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 3.1% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in The Crest?
The Crest also had 6 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in September, against 14 houses listed. The The Crest condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in The Crest?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses listed in The Crest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is The Crest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in The Crest had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in The Crest from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in The Crest over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in The Crest?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
